title: Tight collar syncope = carotid sinus hypersensitivity (IX afferent → vagal outflow)

properties.Correct answer: Glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX) afferents from carotid sinus (Hering nerve)
properties.Stem (brief): Syncope/bradycardia triggered by tight collar (carotid sinus hypersensitivity): which nerve carries afferent baroreceptor signals?
properties.Takeaway (1 sentence): Carotid sinus baroreceptor reflex: IX in, X out → bradycardia + hypotension.
properties.One-liner (Key concept): Tight collar syncope = carotid sinus hypersensitivity (IX afferent → vagal outflow)
